preconditions.description: The size of the permutation n is between 1 and 300000.
The length of the permutation list is equal to n.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= n for x in permutation)
preconditions.description: Each element in the permutation is between 1 and n.
All elements in the permutation are unique.

postconditions.expression: any(a < b / a < c for a, b, c in zip(permutation, permutation[1:], permutation[2:])) or any(c < b / a < a for a, b, c in zip(permutation, permutation[1:], permutation[2:]))
postconditions.description: There exists a pair of integers a, b such that b/a is between a and b in the permutation.
